sentences.text: Conor Anthony McGregor -LRB- Irish : Conchúr Antóin Mac Gréagóir ; born 14 July 1988 -RRB- is an Irish professional mixed martial artist who is currently signed to the Ultimate Fighting Championship -LRB- UFC -RRB- .	Irish	Irish language	mixed martial artist	mixed martial arts	Ultimate Fighting Championship	Ultimate Fighting Championship

In 2008 , McGregor started his mixed martial arts -LRB- MMA -RRB- career and , in 2012 , he won both the Cage Warriors Featherweight and Lightweight Championships , holding both titles concurrently before vacating them to sign with the UFC . This was the fastest victory in UFC title fight history .
